flavor.text: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.
They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.
Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
It can see the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s life span, it cries in sadness.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.
